categories.name: Admission to Normal Care
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a normal care inpatient ward (Admission NC), advancing the organization's valued goal of appropriate bed allocation while measured against discharge capture and readmission indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 15 (Admission NC) under the OR-decomposition for patient admission (id=5), as observed in variants such as V0008.

categories.name: Admission to Intensive Care
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care unit (Admission IC). It incurs a negative contribution (-25) to minimizing time-to-treatment softgoals, and is measured against discharge and readmission performance.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 16 (Admission IC) under the OR-decomposition for patient admission (id=5), supported by variants like V0605 and V0317.
